items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Oh, he's a fine trumpet player.

ctx.x: Oh, he's a fine trumpet player. Did he use mutes too? Yeah, I was with Joe reading music, I'm sure he did.
I mean, did he use those mutes like you were saying, McCary? Did he use any?
No, no, he used ordinary mutes and all that.
